messages:
Priya: Opened a PR to consolidate quota-tier docs, add migration notes, replace raw panel ids with friendly slugs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4301 :link:
Ben: thanks — which pages will change? snippets, migration guide, billing FAQ?
Priya: all three. summary: rename panels to `quota-by-plan`, add Python + JS SDK examples showing tier filter, clarify deprecation window for old slug `quota_tiers_old` (we're proposing a 60d alias), and fix two broken links in the billing faq.
Max: can you drop the Python snippet here so I can sanity-check? keep it short.
Priya: snippet draft:
```python
import os, requests
resp = requests.get(
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage",
  params={"panel":"quota-by-plan","tier":"enterprise","window":"30d"},
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY']}"},
)
print(resp.json())
```
Ben: looks good. tiny suggestion: mention pagination (`per_page` + `page`) in the comment or example.
Priya: good call — will add a one-line note.
Devex Bot: @Priya, docs linter checklist: 1) update sidebar redirects 2) update snippets/usage.md 3) add a migration table old->new slugs in migration.md 4) add a CI assertion that `quota-by-plan` exists in dashboard.json
Nina: billing — aliasing old slug for 60 days OK? pinging @Marta for signoff.
Marta: fine with 60d aliasing as long as we create a monitoring alert if traffic to `quota_tiers_old` is still >5% after 30d.
Ben: also add a short note in the FAQ about expected numbers changing slightly after migration (tokens vs requests rounding).
Max: I'll review the PR now; if CI is green and docs linter passes, we can merge today.
Priya: thanks — pushing a follow-up commit with pagination note, the migration table, and the CI check in `.github/workflows/docs-validate.yml`.
Devex Bot: Automated update: CI job `docs-links-and-snippets` passed on push.
Marta: SGTM :white_check_mark:
Priya: merging after Max gives final ack. cheers! :tada:
